## Wave Life Sciences to Present at Chardan’s 10th Annual Healthcare Conference


October 13, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.wavelifesciences.com/node/13421/pdf)


CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Wave Life Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: WVE), a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on unlocking the broad potential of RNA medicines to transform human health, today announced that Paul Bolno, MD, MBA, President and Chief Executive Officer, is scheduled to participate in the “RNA Medicines: Next-Generation RNA Therapeutics” panel at Chardan’s 10th Annual Healthcare Conference in New York City on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 9:45 a.m. ET.


A live webcast of the panel can be accessed by visiting “Investor Events” on the Investors section of the Wave Life Sciences website:[https://ir.wavelifesciences.com/events-publications/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=MZDfu7wYB9sDFitpO2gJeXhyJ1HKu6iYDdaRQ1q6XPAdg4mauN1gzxic9MX3diS7Qml8Sfnt2TerRuj9TUeF_2-Zd68Vg7XTpMRmohyEXOhPbpxglW46a6llkZ11aDBLxNDirFY1NstBSlVPmy8y1lxLl6GgGXCGqsuhi4y6XcasX-qJKQ_lrz9nROpuFsRk) . A replay of this panel will be archived and available on the site for a limited time following the event.


**About Wave Life Sciences**
Wave Life Sciences (Nasdaq: WVE) is a biotechnology company focused on unlocking the broad potential of RNA medicines to transform human health. Wave’s PRISM® platform combines multiple RNA medicine modalities, chemistry innovation, and deep insights in human genetics to deliver scientific breakthroughs that treat both rare and common disorders. Its toolkit of RNA-targeting modalities, including RNAi (SpiNA) and RNA editing (AIMers), provides Wave with unmatched capabilities for designing and sustainably delivering candidates that optimally address disease biology. Wave’s pipeline is focused on its obesity (WVE-007), alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (WVE-006) and PNPLA3 I148M liver disease (WVE-008) programs, and also includes clinical programs in Duchenne muscular dystrophy and Huntington’s disease, as well as several preclinical programs utilizing the company’s versatile RNA medicines platform. Driven by the calling to “Reimagine Possible,” Wave is leading the charge toward a world in which human potential is no longer hindered by the burden of disease. Wave is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. For more information on Wave’s science, pipeline and people, please visit[www.wavelifesciences.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_n7UDzjPHSTRm1-HyiJKmHeevjUbbnahs073aj1opjW7RTXKBqlrCiNfEyargSLTr-I-EBzCL2OYnpPdVXDCWVoSbqCJXd-lAnS_eExhQ6IATgFyhEbAJGOQRkCq2ew3) and follow Wave on[X](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DiyzcCd5HX_SDV5g-hKDJK1jw-z1GbkHR69lkZ64ehZLKRrgrXOCVjdFk1MSqbWnS8yIOrf9OvW2e0UWYyrAyw==) and[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ANUFdTRT8JD8GIog3h2YboGD8SIAf1rLEzn1bnmLimMnmZmtkVMkSwkPU3td5Vr_WTUx0MxWZkAhfkkaRR0X7MCY7VMSE6G0WgdL5O2In7pvnFYEhCghWMnLyMRfRynV) .
